baseline: Latest stable non-yanked official PyPI release resolved at phase start; pinned wheel and SHA256 in baseline_manifest.json.
primary_output: Complete actual public FluidState return, all numerical leaves synchronized; no lazy/export-only substitute for full-state timing.
repetition_calibration: Before acceptance, cap requested repetitions using eight untimed warmups to target20ms for slow workloads; never belowone call. Fastnative calls retain requested repetitions. Record perworker effectivecalls, normalizepercall,alternatevariantsacrosssamples,keep9samples/4workers andallaccuracy/budgetrequirements.

budgets.accepted_phase7_scope: Only explicitly identified closed-model PG compiled 1024-state complete returns (PT/HP/PS and scalar/array pressure variants), within the user's previously accepted 31-38% complete-batch tradeoff. This scope is declared before acceptance timing. Strict 10% flags remain visible. No dynamic-model/consumer/projection exceptions are inferred.

construction.reason: Required verified source/reference/native identity and calibration prepared at setup; approximately 4 ms source provenance cost recorded in Phase11.

cached_loading.reason: Full manifest, source/native/reference and numerical payload validation retained; accepted Phase11 loading is approximately92 ms versus original approximately23 ms. No validation disabled.

fresh_generation.reason: Additional construction-time source-domain/envelope validation; equal physical domain/resolution/gradient settings required.

first_public_call.reason: Separate cold compilation/binding cost, including complete states/status and additional materialized properties.

state_inspection.reason: Diagnostic property/metadata access now enforces supported/available fields; not a thermodynamic evaluation substitute.

state_construction.reason: Public user-created states now validate canonical schema, availability, shape, status and immutable metadata. Evaluator trusted assembly remains included in full-state timings.

correctness.unavailable: NaNs only match when both outcomes are declared unavailable. Intentional changed optional-property definitions are excluded by explicit per-case field lists and recorded as semantic differences.
correctness.shape: Keep actual returned shapes and dtypes in timing records. Compare complete arrays and unavailable masks, not sampled values. Only declared old PG broadcast/scalar-pressure cases may expand their genuine scalar/partial-axis constant coordinates to the common physical shape outside timing. Arbitrary unequal lengths cannot pass.
correctness.status: Validate all current primal statuses; legacy has no status and receives no fabricated status success output.
correctness.pg: Matched public-model constants/reference/transport parameters allow common13 equality; as-shipped calibration differences receive independent per-model identities and explicit comparison exclusions.
correctness.tables: Identical declared domains/resolutions/gradient settings and independent source checks at1e-3 relative interpolation accuracy plus AD-vs-finite-difference1e-5; cross-version field tolerances remain tighter. No demand for bitwise identical old coefficient arrays after intentional source repairs.
correctness.homogeneous_water_model_correction: Only explicitly named Water homogeneous/metastable cases allow cross-version rtol3e-5 for the repaired universal-vs-source gas-constant bias (old liquid pressure error about1.064e-5 relative). The two vapor_HP_inverse cases alone use5e-5 because the same known physical-model bias shifts their inverse density/temperature roots by up to3.6888e-5. Current states must still pass strict independent raw-source checks; old p/h/u/s must match the independently reconstructed published gas-constant formula. Solver tolerances remain matched; these are documented physical-model corrections, not arbitrary root-error allowances.

unique_python_numbers: Use never-before-seen timed Python floats, not previously warmed validation inputs; record compiler events and including-compilation time separately from warmed JAX-array calls.
scope_limits: CPU/x64 device profile; no inferred GPU performance.
Optional REFPROP is run when installed, with absence explicit.
New-only functionality has independent checks and no invented published-version speedup.
Standalone JaxProp consumers only; ThermOpt remains final Phase14.
